expectations.text: 响应中明确指出 Harness Engineering 不是“无论什么请求都把 Layer 0 到 Layer 6 全讲一遍”的静态清单
expectations.evidence: The title and opening paragraphs reject `七层念经` and describe HE as a control framework instead of a ritual.

expectations.text: 响应中提及应先判定 `bootstrap` / `maintenance`，再决定最小起始层或重入层
expectations.evidence: It explicitly says the entry question is `bootstrap 还是 maintenance` and then to select the smallest impacted layer.

expectations.text: 响应中明确说明新 feature 不能跳过能力边界检查或单组件 MVP 验证直接写 PRD
expectations.evidence: The second half explains that jumping to Layer 4 PRD work without Layer 0-1 proof violates the method.

expectations.text: 响应中明确说明维护期问题不需要每次完整回放 Layer 0->6
expectations.evidence: The maintenance example says a local bug under stable contracts should start at Layer 6 instead of replaying Layer 0→6.

expectations.text: 响应中把这套方法讲成推进关系、delivery arc 或等价的方法论，而不是只枚举层号
expectations.evidence: It reframes HE as `证据驱动的范围控制` and a decision/control framework rather than a checklist.

eval_feedback.overall: All expectations passed. The baseline answer is very explicit and pedagogical, though much more verbose than the with-skill version.
